## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, and `cargo test --workspace` pass
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `[Unreleased]` for user-facing changes
- [ ] Screenshots are included for interface changes
- [ ] No real session content, credentials, or personal paths in code, fixtures, or screenshots
